premises.text: Women want coveted in-season handbags and accessories that rarely go on sale, at a price they choose
premises.evidence_span: choose the price they want to pay for the most coveted handbags and accessories that either never or rarely go on sale

premises.text: Members buy credits and enter descending-price sales where price falls faster as more players join
premises.evidence_span: This price drops lower every second. In fact, it drops faster as more and more members join the sale

premises.text: Limited inventory ends the game; losers get brand gift cards or incentives
premises.evidence_span: There's only a limited amount of inventory in each sale, and as soon as it's sold out, the game ends

premises.text: Revenue from merchandise markup plus entrance fees yields ~60% gross margin
premises.evidence_span: we collect a markup between the wholesale cost of an item and its final sale price on the site. Second, we collect entrance fees from each player

premises.text: Acquisition via targeted PPC, SEO, and incentivized referrals at ARPU that covers CAC
premises.evidence_span: we looked at our current conversion rate for our pay-per-click ads, SEO work, and our referral program

premises.text: Brands get cost-effective buzz for in-season goods as they hit department stores
premises.evidence_span: helping to create buzz around their in-season merchandise just as it's hitting the department store floors

value.text: In-season luxury accessories at member-chosen prices with game-driven demand
value.evidence_span: focus on in-season merchandise while using a game-like element to build buzz and create new demand

secondary_value.text: Luxury brands gain accessible buzz without traditional ad spend alone
secondary_value.evidence_span: making brands more accessible to consumers and consumers more accessible to brands

causal_links.evidence_span: game-like element to build buzz and create new demand
value proposition for brands is just as strong
